shots.alt: Claude Code running /review:plan on a change that drops a database column: fourpass, migrations, impact and regressions would run, each with the files that selected it and what it costs, and testgaps is offered afterwards.

shots.name: readonly-guard
shots.alt: The read-only guard's selftest for the impact analyst: git diff and a read-only GitHub MCP call are allowed; rm, a redirect to a file, Write and an MCP call that posts a comment are denied.

shots.alt: ./scripts/check.sh --tests docs: the shared checks, then the docs plugin's five suites and its guard selftest, ending with all checks passed.
